STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE
Moderna, Inc. | QA-MFG

Document Number: QA-MFG-8428-91
Title: Equipment Cleaning and Sanitization
Version: 3.2
Effective Date: 10 April 2026
Review Date: 16 October 2026
Author: Edward Torres
Approved By: Johnny Johnson, VP Quality
Department: QA-MFG
1. Purpose
This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) defines the requirements and step-by-step instructions for equipment cleaning and sanitization at Moderna, Inc. manufacturing facilities. This SOP ensures compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) regulations as defined in 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211, and applicable ICH guidelines.
2. Scope
This SOP applies to all personnel involved in equipment cleaning and sanitization operations at Moderna, Inc. facilities. This includes manufacturing operators, QC analysts, and QA personnel responsible for oversight.
3. Responsibilities
Role
Responsibility








Manufacturing Operator
Performs all steps as described in this SOP; reports deviations immediately
QC Analyst
Performs in-process and release testing; reviews results for compliance
QA Manager
Provides oversight; approves deviations; ensures SOP compliance
Department Supervisor
Ensures personnel training; reviews SOP adherence during operations
4. Materials and Equipment
Calibrated eat measurement instrument (ID: EQ-4432-95)
Certified reference standards lot #44993
Personal protective equipment (PPE) per safety guidelines
Approved reagents as per Bill of Materials BOM-2169-87
Cleanroom classified area (ISO Class 5 or as specified in batch record)
5. Procedure
5.1 Verify all equipment calibration certificates are current and within acceptable limits.
5.2 Complete environmental monitoring checks and confirm area is within specification.
5.3 Review and sign Batch Manufacturing Record (BMR) prior to commencing operations.
5.4 Perform equipment cleaning and sanitization according to the approved batch record instructions.
5.5 Record all process parameters, observations, and measurements in the BMR in real time.
5.6 Collect in-process samples at defined intervals and submit to QC for testing.
5.7 Any deviation from this procedure must be immediately reported to the supervisor and documented per SOP QA-DEV-3803-78.
5.8 Upon completion, clean and sanitize all equipment and workspace per SOP QA-CLN-5010-30.
6. Acceptance Criteria
All in-process and final product specifications must be met as defined in the approved Drug Product specification document SPEC-8573-58. Out-of-specification (OOS) results must be investigated per SOP QA-OOS-5422-91.
7. References
21 CFR Part 210 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice in Manufacturing Processing
21 CFR Part 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice for Finished Pharmaceuticals
ICH Q10 - Pharmaceutical Quality System
ICH Q9 - Quality Risk Management
Moderna, Inc. Quality Manual QM-001
